RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

The panel's composition can't explain this outcome. Both you and the successful candidate are men, so an all-male panel had no sex-based reason to prefer him over you. An unbalanced panel is a legitimate governance criticism of a public broadcaster, but it isn't evidence of bias against you, and raising it will look like you're reaching — weakening the complaint you do have.

Your real points are stronger: the unanswered request for written reasons after two weeks, and whether "strong experience of digital media" was a stated, weighted criterion in the advertised person specification or introduced afterwards. If it appeared late, and favoured a candidate with roughly half your experience, that's the thread to pull — including a possible age dimension.
